To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we propose two novel erasure resilient coding classes (basic pyramid codes and generalized pyramid codes), (2) we show how these codes are constructed from any existing code and how they can further improve access and/or reliability, and (3) we establish a necessary and sufficient condition for any failure to be recoverable and show that our codes achieve this optimal condition.

we have developed two classes of erasures resilient coding schemes, the basic pyramid codes that can be derived from any existing code and generalized pyramid codes that are new, advanced and optimal, for reliable data storage systems to flexibly explore the space-access trade-offs.
we have developed two classes of flexible coding schemes that can trade space for access efficiency in reliable storage systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
two major problems in reliable storage systems.

the fundamental problem of how to flexibly trade off storage space for access efficiency and/or failure recovery in reliable data storage, which is of great interest to both the theory and practice of reliable data storage.
two major problems in reliable data storage: how to efficiently encode and decode data, and how to flexibly trade space for access efficiency.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the generalized pyramid coding scheme can be used to trade space for access efficiency in reliable distributed storage systems.
the generalized pyramid code family is the most flexible class of coding schemes that can be employed in reliable data storage applications.
, with the proposed pyramid codes, we can flexibly explore the optimal trade-offs between storage efficiency and access efficiency in data storage systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the pyramid codes provide a flexible platform to explore the trade-offs among storage space, access efficiency and failure recovery, and can be applied to various data storage systems such as cloud storage and distributed storage systems, to improve their storage space efficiency or access efficiency.
we provide flexible schemes to trade storage space for access efficiency in reliable storage systems, and we also show that the generalized codes are optimal in access efficiency.
, the generalized pyramid codes provide the best known trade-offs between storage and access efficiency for any given reliability.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, by judiciously combining the basic and generalized pyramid coding schemes, one can flexibly trade storage space for access efficiency in reliable storage systems.
the pyramid codes can be easily constructed, and the generalized pyramid codes can be used to further optimize access efficiency and/or storage reliability in practical data storage systems.
, by using pyramid codes, we can flexibly explore the space-access efficiency trade-offs in reliable data storage system design, and achieve the best trade-offs in terms of failure recovery.
